OLD TOM

DISTILLERY

KENTUCKY STRAIGHT
BOURBON WHISKEY

SMALL BATCH - SLOW AGED

45% Alc./Vol. (90 Proof)
750 mL

DISTILLED AND BOTTLED BY
Old Tom Distillery, Bardstown, KY

GOVERNMENT WARNING:

(1) According to the Surgeon General, women should not drink
alcoholic beverages during pregnancy because of the risk of
birth defects. (2) Consumption of alcoholic beverages impairs
your ability to drive a car or operate machinery, and may
cause health problems.
